title: A Private Space's own domain stops serving a share card, and an unpublish expires the card with the site

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), website cluster review of #3318 (LIVE-870).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: the hosted share card resolved a custom domain through getSpaceByDomain, which checks status but not visibility and is untagged. A Private Space with its own domain and a published website still served a card with its name, headline, logo and cover while every page 404'd, and because the route is ISR for an hour with no site:<slug> tag, refreshSite on an unpublish did not expire it. THE FIX: the route re-reads the resolved Space through getSiteSpace, the visibility-checked read tagged site:<slug> that the pages use.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/hosted/[host]/opengraph-image/route.tsx','utf8');if(!/hosted \? await getSiteSpace\(hosted\.slug\)/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-817: the hosted share card reads the Space without the visibility check or the site tag');process.exit(1)}"
